description: Erreur de typage LSP simple : affectation d'une chaîne à une variable de type entier.
expected_lsp_state: Diagnostic: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.

description: Violation de dépendance circulaire : Module A importe Module B qui importe Module A.
expected_lsp_state: Warning: Circular dependency detected between A.ts and B.ts

description: Fuite mémoire simple : ajout continu d'éléments dans un tableau global sans nettoyage.
initial_code: const cache: any[] = []; function compute() { cache.push(new Array(10000)); } setInterval(compute, 10);
expected_lsp_state: No LSP error, runtime memory leak expected.

description: Faute de logique : condition toujours fausse (unreachable code).
initial_code: function check(x: boolean) { if (x && !x) { return true; } return false; }
expected_lsp_state: Diagnostic: This condition will always return 'false'.

description: Erreur de typage LSP : propriété manquante dans une interface.
initial_code:
interface User { id: number; name: string; }
const u: User = { id: 1 };
expected_lsp_state: Diagnostic: Property 'name' is missing in type '{ id: number; }' but required in type 'User'.

description: Faute de logique : boucle infinie simple sans incrémentation.
expected_lsp_state: No LSP error, runtime infinite loop expected.

description: Fuite mémoire potentielle : Event listener global jamais retiré.
expected_lsp_state: No LSP error, static analysis leak warning.

description: Violation de dépendance : importation d'un module interne non exporté par le package.
expected_lsp_state: Diagnostic: Module 'library/dist/internal' has no exported member 'internalFunc'.

description: Erreur de typage LSP : Promesse non gérée (floating promise).
initial_code:
async function fetchData() { return 1; }
function main() { fetchData(); }
expected_lsp_state: Diagnostic: Promises must be awaited, end with a call to .catch, or end with a call to .then

description: Faute de logique : redéclaration d'une variable block-scoped.
